en.basel-kadem: We were told of that by Muhammed bin Hasan, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Idrees, from Muhammed bin Ahmad, that he said: We were told by Abu Muhammed, Ja’far bin Ahmad bin Sa’eed al-Bajali, the son of the brother from Sawfan bin Yahya, from Ali bin Asbat, from Saif bin ‘Umayra, from Abu’s-Sabah bin Na’eem al-‘A’idhi, from Muhammed bin Muslim,

that he said in a narration in which he says in its ending: The Glorification of (what was performed by) Fatima, peace be upon him, is among the mentioning of Allah in abundance about which Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He, said: «So mention Me, (and) I will mention you.» [2:152]
